eli: Datadog alert: unusually high SELECT volume from service-account svc-analytics (analytics_ro) against users_pii table starting ~2026-03-18T03:12Z. alert id DD-9876 :warning:
ashley (secops): grabbing audit logs now, on it. can you paste sample audit lines?
eli: pg_audit snippet: `timestamp=2026-03-18T03:13:02Z user=svc-analytics db=prod query="SELECT id,email,created_at FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%@%'" rows=42000 duration=12000ms` — that pattern repeated ~30x in 6m window.
mike (db): are these COPY TO or plain SELECTs? need session + pid to trace.
eli: plain SELECTs, no LIMIT. origin IP 10.240.5.18 (k8s pod prod-analytics-2), auth token sa-analytics-01. headers shows no internal admin tag.
ashley (secops): immediate containment: revoke sa-analytics-01 token and blacklist pod IP. tagging @compliance. do not delete logs.
compliance: preserving logs and opening incident. create ticket INC-2026-142; legal hold enabled for affected data until review. do not purge.
mike (db): blocking connection at load-balancer and removed analytics_ro SELECT on users_pii role. applied RBAC change at 2026-03-18T03:22Z.
infra-bot: deploy:network-blacklist 10.240.5.18 applied by mike at 1767800180
eli: forwarding full audit stream to Splunk now (index=incidents, tag=INC-2026-142). uploading query hashes and sample rows to ticket.
ashley (secops): suggested follow-ups: 1) require query limits (max rows) on analytics services; 2) add enforced COPY/export endpoint with stronger auth; 3) KMS key access review + rotate wrapping key for service accounts with export perms; 4) add anomaly rule for SELECT-rate per service-account in Datadog. assigning owners in ticket.
kevin (sre): I'll add Prometheus / Alertmanager rule and hand off runbook for paging.
compliance: collecting affected customer IDs now, please DM me the list of customer IDs and retention windows.
eli: running a safe replay against a snapshot (read-only) to enumerate rows touched, will attach CSVs to the incident ticket (no exfil of customer data outside secure storage).
ashley (secops): summary: token revoked, IP blocked, RBAC tightened, logs preserved and forwarded, INC-2026-142 created (severity P2). postmortem meeting scheduled 11:00 PST. :white_check_mark:
